deities: Goddess Kali (black idol in the sanctum sanctorum)

history.period: 20th century (colonial-era origins; one crowdsourced listing claims 1940 CE - verify)
history.summary: The Kali Mandir at New Colony Veng, Saiha (PIN 796901), is the only Hindu temple in Saiha with any substantive published write-up. A single crowdsourced heritage listing states it serves the local Bengali Hindu community and was built around 1940 (verify); the same source admits the exact construction date is elusive and attributes its origin to oral tradition from the British colonial period. It is a modest modern concrete structure with an orange-and-white facade on a small hillock overlooking the town, in a North Indian temple style with a local Mizo-influenced sloping roof. The listing's claims of an ASI survey and of a 'Bengal Renaissance Period' origin are almost certainly spurious and should not be repeated as fact. No founder, builder or dynasty is documented.

name: Saiha Kali Mandir
town_description: Saiha (officially Siaha) is the district headquarters of Saiha district in southern Mizoram, near the Myanmar border, and the principal town of the Mara Autonomous District Council. Home to the Mara tribe, who are overwhelmingly Christian, it is one of Mizoram's fastest-growing towns. A small Hindu minority - Bengali traders, government staff and paramilitary personnel - maintains the town's few community temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), approx. 300-315 km by road / about 5 hours (verify). Pawan Hans helicopter service links Aizawl and Saiha (verify current operation).
travel.railway: Nearest railhead not reliably published (verify); candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Ambassa/Dharmanagar (Tripura).
travel.road: Approx. 378 km from Aizawl via NH 54 (per Wikipedia), with regular buses and jeeps.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for weather (15-25 C); Durga Puja / Kali Puja season for festivals (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-9:00 PM daily, free entry (verify - single uncorroborated crowdsourced listing).
